arxiv-1911-12095.title: Plasma Cash: Towards more efficient Plasma constructions
arxiv-1911-12095.creator: Georgios Konstantopoulos
arxiv-1911-12095.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Georgios Konstantopoulos. Plasma is a framework for scalable off-chain computation. We describe and evaluate Plasma Cash, an improved Plasma construction which leverages non-fungible tokens and Sparse Merkle Trees to reduce the data storage and bandwith requirements for users. We analyze the cryptoeconomic exit and challenge mechanisms used to keep user funds secured, even when the Plasma Cash chain’s consensus algorithm is compromised. A reference implementation is provided for evaluation.

arxiv-2202-08069.title: VLDB 2021: Designing a Hybrid Conference
arxiv-2202-08069.creator: Pınar Tözün, Felix Naumann, Philippe Bonnet, Xin Luna Dong
arxiv-2202-08069.description: Abstract . In 2020, while main database conferences one by one ( Bonifati et al. 2020 ; Maier et al. 2020 ) had to adopt a virtual format as a result of the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, we decided to hold VLDB 2021 in hybrid format.

arxiv-2404-03756.title: Robust finite element solvers for distributed hyperbolic optimal control problems
arxiv-2404-03756.creator: Ulrich Langer, Richard Löscher, Olaf Steinbach, Huidong Yang
arxiv-2404-03756.description: Abstract We propose, analyze, and test new robust iterative solvers for systems of linear algebraic equations arising from the space-time finite element discretization of reduced optimality systems defining the approximate solution of hyperbolic distributed, tracking-type optimal control problems with both the standard L 2 L^{2} and the more general energy regularizations.

arxiv-2506-18993.title: Direct Collapse pre-SMBH Objects as Ly α \alpha Emitters
arxiv-2506-18993.creator: Yang Luo, Isaac Shlosman
arxiv-2506-18993.description: Abstract Direct Collapse scenario to form the supermassive black hole (SMBH) seeds offers the most promising way to explain the origin of quasars at z > 7 z>7 . Assuming atomic primordial gas, can Ly α \alpha photons escape from the central regions of the collapse and serve as a diagnostic for the detection of these pre-SMBH objects?

arxiv-2510-23374.title: The MiMO Catalog: Physical Parameters and Stellar Mass Functions of 1,232 Open Clusters from Gaia DR3
arxiv-2510-23374.creator: Lu Li (李璐), Zhengyi Shao (邵正义), Zhaozhou Li (李昭洲), Xiaoting Fu (符晓婷)
arxiv-2510-23374.description: Abstract We present a homogeneous catalog of 1,232 open clusters with precisely determined ages, metallicities, distances, extinctions, and stellar mass function (MF) slopes, derived from Gaia DR3 data. The parameters are inferred using the Mixture Model for Open clusters (MiMO), a novel Bayesian framework for modeling clusters in the color-magnitude diagram.

pmc-11311607.title: A Review of Nanotechnology in microRNA Detection and Drug Delivery
pmc-11311607.creator: Hsiuying Wang
pmc-11311607.description: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are small, non-coding RNAs that play a crucial role in regulating gene expression. Dysfunction in miRNAs can lead to various diseases, including cancers, neurological disorders, and cardiovascular conditions. To date, approximately 2000 miRNAs have been identified in humans. These small molecules have shown promise as disease biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets.

pmc-11403458.title: New distribution record, morphological and molecular characterization of Dirofilaria (Nochtiella) tenuis (Nematoda: Onchocercidae) in raccoons (Procyon lotor) from the Yucatan Peninsula, Mexico
pmc-11403458.creator: Aarón Hernández-Núñez, Víctor M Vidal-Martínez, M Leopoldina Aguirre-Macedo
pmc-11403458.description: Dirofilaria (Nochtiella) tenuis is a mosquito-borne subcutaneous parasite of raccoons, regarded as the causative agent of most human dirofilarial infections in North America. Despite the wide geographic range of raccoons in the Americas, the presence of this parasite has not been confirmed outside its known endemic areas in the Southern United States.

pmc-11431477.title: Immunotherapy in Patients with Advanced Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer Under-Represented by Clinical Trials
pmc-11431477.creator: Daniel E Meyers, Rebekah Rittberg, David E Dawe, Shantanu Banerji
pmc-11431477.description: Since the initial US FDA approval of an immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) for the treatment of non-oncogene-driven non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) nine years ago, this therapeutic strategy has been cemented as a crucial component of treatment for most of these patients.

pmc-11621391.title: Relationship between hypertransmission defect size and progression in eyes with intermediate age-related macular degeneration
pmc-11621391.creator: Onnisa Nanegrungsunk, Giulia Corradetti, Phichayut Phinyo, Janejit Choovuthayakorn, Srinivas R Sadda
pmc-11621391.description: ObjectivesTo determine the associations between the presence of various-sized hypertransmission defects (hyperTDs) and progression to incomplete retinal pigment epithelial (RPE) and outer retinal atrophy (iRORA) and complete RORA (cRORA) in eyes with intermediate age-related macular degeneration (iAMD).MethodsOptical coherence tomography (OCT) data from consecutive iAMD patients, were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-11738729.title: Consideration of Clozapine in Patients With Treatment Resistant Schizophrenia
pmc-11738729.creator: Niema Moazzami, Aimee Devereux
pmc-11738729.description: AimsThe aim of the audit is to measure the performance of Bradford District Care Trust (BDCT) against the NICE guideline's quality standard: ‘Adults with schizophrenia that has not responded adequately to treatment with at least 2 antipsychotic drugs are offered clozapine.’MethodsWe identified the 273 patients prescribed clozapine in BDCT as of January 2023.

pmc-12505067.title: Factors affecting implementation of a National Clinical Programme for self-harm in hospital emergency departments: a qualitative study
pmc-12505067.creator: Selena O'Connell, Grace Cully, Sheena McHugh, Margaret Maxwell, Anne Jeffers, Katerina Kavalidou, Sally Lovejoy, Rhona Jennings, Vincent Russell, Ella Arensman, Eve Griffin
pmc-12505067.description: BackgroundA substantial number of people experiencing self-harm or suicidal ideation present to hospital emergency departments (EDs). In 2014, a National Clinical Programme was introduced in EDs in Ireland to standardise care provision. Internationally, there has been limited research on the factors affecting the implementation of care for people who present with mental health crises in EDs.

pmc-13031804.title: Evaluating the accuracy of ChatGPT model versions for giving care-seeking advice
pmc-13031804.creator: Marvin Kopka, Longqi He, Markus A Feufel
pmc-13031804.description: Background:Artificial Intelligence tools such as ChatGPT are increasingly used by laypeople to support their care-seeking decisions, although the accuracy of newer models remains unclear. We aimed to evaluate the accuracy of care-seeking advice that is generated by all currently available ChatGPT models.Methods:We evaluated 22 ChatGPT models using 45 validated vignettes, each prompted ten times (9,900 total assessments).

pmc-13118327.title: National Reference Values of FFMI and FMI Using Body Composition Chart in Korean Adults
pmc-13118327.creator: Hyeoijin Kim, Yong Hee Hong, Young Charles Jang, Youngil Lee, Jae Young Lee, Seon Ho Eom, Sochung Chung, Chul-Hyun Kim
pmc-13118327.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Body mass index (BMI) cannot distinguish fat mass (FM) from fat-free mass (FFM). The fat-free mass index (FFMI = FFM/height2) and fat mass index (FMI = FM/height2) decompose BMI into lean and fat components. We aimed to establish the first nationally representative, BIA-based FFMI and FMI reference values for Korean adults, visualize body composition trajectories, and classify obesity subtypes using the body composition chart.

pmc-13181088.title: The SUV rear wheel axle under different loading conditions at digital image correlation approach for road safety
pmc-13181088.creator: Jarosław Krzysztof Gonera, Tadeusz Szymczak, Paweł Dziedziak
pmc-13181088.description: This study focuses on measuring changes in the rear-axle wheel alignment of an SUV under various load levels and load arrangements, using the Digital Image Correlation approach with the PONTOS 5 M system. Four load cases were applied, covering the passenger and luggage compartments, with maximum masses of 200 and 300 kg, respectively.
